A player who has consistently beaten (or missed) our earlier forecasts gets a shrunk adjustment toward that record. Observed averages below are unweighted. Participation and current role remain unconfirmed.

build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many shots the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 354 shots against 321.4 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.
